betterpvp.midnightconfig.title: Better PvP Config
betterpvp.midnightconfig.autoAttack: Auto Attack (hold attack = auto swing when the bar is full)
betterpvp.midnightconfig.extraDelayTicks: Extra delay after the bar is full (ticks, 1 = safer for full damage)
betterpvp.midnightconfig.attackOther: Auto attack with other items (hand, pickaxe, etc.)
betterpvp.midnightconfig.critOnlyFullCha: Only crit when the attack bar is above 90%
betterpvp.midnightconfig.jumpReset: Jump Reset (auto jump when you get hit)
betterpvp.midnightconfig.preventsHitting: Prevents you from hitting blocks in all tools
Prevents you from hitting blocks only in swords
betterpvp.midnightconfig.cleanCut: Attack enemies through obstructions (similar to CleanCut Mod)
betterpvp.midnightconfig.autoBow: Enables automatic shots with the bow
betterpvp.midnightconfig.autoCrossBow: Enables automatic shots with the crossbow
betterpvp.midnightconfig.autoTrident: Enables automatic shots with the trident
betterpvp.midnightconfig.alwaysAttack: Attacks even when there are no entities in range
key.betterpvp.autoRanged: Toggle automatic fire with ranged weapons
